text:
Ava (Marketing): Hey folks — new draft of the launch blog is in the Google doc (https://docs.google.com/example). Angle: Redwood Optimize walkthrough + short benchmark note + a tiny embeddings example for devs. I put the CTAs and lead-routing notes in the bottom. Need legal + sales signoff by Tue 5pm PT so we can push to CMS Wed AM.

Diego (Content): Nice. I'm pasting a compact embed snippet to include inline so engineers can copy it quickly:
```bash
# quick embeddings example (curl)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"open-embed-lite","input":"Describe Redwood Optimize benefits"}'
```

Diego (Content): And a tiny response example to show shape: ```json
{"embedding":[0.013,-0.024,0.041,...],"model":"open-embed-lite"}```

Nina (Legal): Quick review: overall copy looks clean. Two asks before I approve: 1) The line "up to 60% lower token spend" needs a source — either provide a benchmark note or change to qualitative language (e.g., "substantially lower per-token spend with batching and caching"). 2) Change any SLA phrasing to "SLA applies where contracted". After that I'm good.

Sam (Sales): CTA routing proposal (typing while I skim doc):
- CTA 1: "Request a demo" -> HubSpot form hb-622 (route: AE-enterprise)
- CTA 2: "Try Hosted API" -> /signup?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_launch (route: growth-sdr)
- CTA 3: "Watch a demo webinar" -> Eventbrite link -> webhook to HubSpot list "Optimize-Webinar-24" (tag: webinar_reg)
Also: recommend a microflow: if webinar_reg.company_size > 75 OR role in ["Engineering","ML","Product"], set lead_score += 20 and assign to AE queue.

Priya (Growth): Adding: please append utm_medium=blog&utm_content=cta_button to both Try Hosted API and Webinar links so we can split-button attribution. Also suggest short promo code for webinar registrants to track conversions in the email flow.

Ava (Marketing): Good calls. I'll change the numeric claim to "substantially lower per-token spend with batching and caching" and add the SLA caveat Nina requested. Adding UTMs per Priya and the HubSpot IDs per Sam.

Diego (Content): One minor copy tweak: figure caption should read: "Latency and per-token cost measured on supported model variants; actual results vary by workload." Keeps it conservative.

Nina (Legal): That caption works. Also please remove the word "guarantee" from the customer-facing bullets — use "targets" or "SLOs" instead.

Ava (Marketing): Will replace "guarantee" with "targets".

OpsBot: Heads-up: CMS publish slot available on 2024-09-10T09:00Z. Final copy lock: 2024-09-09T16:00Z. If any changes post-lock, ping @ops.

Sam (Sales): I'll validate the HubSpot field mappings and the AE queue automation today. ETA 3 hours.

Priya (Growth): I'll create the UTM tracking sheet and short promo code for webinar registrants, will share a link in the doc.

Diego (Content): Updated the doc with the embed block, caption tweak, and CTA anchors. Left a comment on the hero line; please check.

Ava (Marketing): Thanks — once Nina and Sam drop a :thumbsup: I'll push to the CMS staging entry and tag ops for publish.

Nina (Legal): :thumbsup: approved (CMS must match the doc).

Sam (Sales): :thumbsup: approved — HubSpot mappings look good, will DM the final field IDs to Ops.

Ava (Marketing): Amazing, thanks everyone. Closing this thread; I'll follow up in #marketing when the CMS entry is live.
